<!--
  What HeroSplit shows under the lead: three figures in cards, a row of faces with a proof line, two small
  feature cards, or a quote with its author over three figures.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { HeroContent } from "../blocks/hero-split.types";

export type HeroSplitExtrasProps = {
  content: HeroContent;
  extra?: "stats" | "avatars" | "minis" | "quote" | "none";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";

const { content, extra = "none" } = defineProps<HeroSplitExtrasProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Box v-if="((extra as string) === 'stats')" class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="hero-stats">
    <template v-for="(s, i) in content.stats" :key="s.id">
      <Stack
        v-if="(i < 3)"
        gap="0"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        data-testid="hero-stat"
      >
        <Text size="2xl" weight="semibold">
          {{ s.value }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ s.label }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </template>
  </Box>
  <Group
    v-if="((extra as string) === 'avatars')"
    gap="4"
    align="center"
    class="flex-wrap"
    data-testid="hero-proof"
  >
    <Group gap="2" align="center">
      <template v-for="(p, i) in content.people" :key="p.id">
        <MediaFrame v-if="(i < 4)" :alt="p.author" ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      </template>
    </Group>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {{ content.proof }}
    </Text>
  </Group>
  <Box
    v-if="((extra as string) === 'minis')"
    class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"
    data-testid="hero-minis"
  >
    <template v-for="(f, i) in content.features" :key="f.id">
      <Group
        v-if="(i < 2)"
        gap="4"
        align="start"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
        data-testid="hero-mini"
      >
        <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
          <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="20" />
        </Box>
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ f.title }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ f.text }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    </template>
  </Box>
  <Stack v-if="((extra as string) === 'quote')" gap="6" align="stretch">
    <template v-for="(p, i) in content.people" :key="p.id">
      <Block v-if="(i < 1)" tag="figure" class="flex flex-col gap-4" data-testid="hero-quote">
        <Block tag="blockquote" class="text-lg font-medium">
          {{ p.quote }}
        </Block>
        <Group gap="4" align="center">
          <MediaFrame :alt="p.author" ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ p.author }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ p.role }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Block>
    </template>
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="hero-stats">
      <template v-for="(s, i) in content.stats" :key="s.id">
        <Stack
          v-if="(i < 3)"
          gap="0"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
          data-testid="hero-stat"
        >
          <Text size="2xl" weight="semibold">
            {{ s.value }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ s.label }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </template>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
</template>
